en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), The Triplet on Seeing (Dassanattika)

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and to be abandoned by vision, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is visible and impinging, which is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there arises a state that is visible and impinging, which is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are twenty-one [conditions] for root; twenty-one for predominance … pe … twenty-one for non-disappearance.
